passages.text: Pneumonia is an infection of the lungs. Many germs (bacteria, fungi, parasites, and viruses) can cause pneumonia.

Common symptoms of pneumonia include:
Chest pain when breathing or coughing
Altered mental status (confusion)
Cough
Fatigue (feeling tired)
Fever or chills
Nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea
Shortness of breath
